fact: On 23 October 2025 the NIU project coordinator said the finance ministry's own NIU team runs the enrolment centres and the Brazzaville card production cell, relaunched in September 2025, and that its own development team is building an online NIU verification platform.
title: Relance des opérations de production de la carte NIU
publisher: Ministère des finances, du budget et du portefeuille public
